headline: Francis Marion carry their unbeaten run to North Georgia
dek: Francis Marion's last defeat came at home to UNC Pembroke in October, and their one draw of the season, at Barton, is the only match since that they have not won. No other programme in the conference has won as many as their sixteen.
displaced_by: The 2026-11-13 rematches have been played (Francis Marion beat Lenoir-Rhyne, North Georgia beat Lees-McRae again), so the preview no longer holds; Francis Marion's unbeaten run going to North Georgia replaces it.

pattern.text: The table and the scoring agree at the top: Young Harris, Francis Marion and UNC Pembroke lead both, and the lowest of their totals is still above every other programme's.

wire.line: UNC Pembroke went unbeaten in conference play and still sit behind Young Harris.
